question: Which GLB does each runtime attack clip play in game (RuntimePolish/DA_Knight, after v030s)?
method: Read the native definition: strings of Unreal/Veyr/Content/Characters/Customuse/RuntimePolish/DA_Knight.uasset (git-ignored Content, on disk) give the exact /Game/.../Animations/<Clip>/<Sequence> paths. No Unreal was launched.

Matched each sequence to its normalized GLB through the version chain of import plans: v026 (idle-joins, 8 attack clips) -> v027 (sourced-v027b, replaces LightAttack) -> v028/v029 (blinks only) -> v030k..v030s (docs/knight-complete-20261028/data/import-plan-KnightB-*.json; only RollAttack of the attack family changes, v030s = Sourced_RollAttack_v7).

Rates, damage windows and durations are from the plan and the GLB itself. The binary DA was not parsed for the play-rate floats, so rates are plan values (a native override would show in the v030s activation 'gameplayPlayRate'; none exists for these clips).
caveats: The v026 plan stores GLB paths under Polish20261025/idle-joins/knight/, which no longer exists; the same normalized files live in Polish20261025/knight/ (plan sha256 matches the files there).
Native uassets cannot be hashed against the GLBs here; the sha links are plan sha256 == disk and plan approved_source_sha256 == owner-approved sha.
RuntimePolish/DA_Knight also lists RollAttack (Sourced_RollAttack_v7, owner_approved false). It is not part of the list asked for; recorded below for completeness.

evidence.nativeDefinition: strings of Unreal/Veyr/Content/Characters/Customuse/RuntimePolish/DA_Knight.uasset (the runtime DA) contain the sequence reference below; v030s/DA_KnightB.uasset (the last activated definition, which inherits RuntimePolish/DA_Knight) lists the same path: /Game/Characters/Customuse/KnightB/v027/Animations/LightAttack/Mixamo_Attack_v17
evidence.importPlan: Local/CustomuseAssets/Polish20261025/sourced-v027b/import-plan-KnightB.json (v027, owner_approved true): LightAttack = Mixamo_Attack_v17.glb, rate 1.6, damage window 0.45-0.72, impact 0.585; replaces the v026 LightAttack (LightAttack_BlackKnightReference_Blender_v2r3, rate 3.0). v028..v030s plans contain no LightAttack, so v027 stands.
evidence.ownerApproval: docs/sourced-native-20261025/README.md and source-manifest.json: 'Owner approved walk, slash, run and roll'; v027 plan owner_approved true. Source motion: Local/FabRigTesting/Source/Mixamo/sword and shield slash.fbx (Mixamo, retargeted + weapon-fitted with a hand-fitted blade arc, Exports/Mixamo_Attack_v17.json). The earlier owner-approved Blender overhead LightAttack_BlackKnightReference_Blender_v2r3 is NOT the runtime clip any more.
evidence.note: Unreal ChooseAttackClip(false) returns LightAttack one-handed; AVeyrKnight::StartPrimaryStep (VeyrKnight.cpp, committed HEAD) plays the one-hand primary chain as LightAttack, LightAttack, then HeavyAttack (step 3), and plays the single 'LightCombo' clip only two-handed (`Two&&!HasVisualClip(LightCombo)`); docs/sourced-native-20261025/README.md says the same ('normal one-hand primary chain uses the new slash for steps 1/2'). VeyrKnight.cpp has uncommitted changes from another session in the working tree; this mapping reads the committed version.
